newsitem.title: USA: SF Fed's Parry says Q4 GDP may come in under 2 pct.
newsitem.headline: SF Fed's Parry says Q4 GDP may come in under 2 pct.

text.p: Fourth quarter U.S. Gross Domestic Product may come in below two percent, San Francisco Federal Reserve Bank President Robert Parry said Monday.

"Fourth quarter is likely to be relatively similar (to Q3's two percent) although if I were to bet, it would be lower than two percent," he told reporters after addressing a meeting sponsored by the bank and Tucson Chamber of Commerce.
On recent inflation data, he said "Frankly I think they've turned out better than I expected, (they) impressed me."

"There won't be any big changes in 1997 (in GDP growth and inflation) ... although there is a risk of a slight uptick in inflation," he said, adding that overall CPI and its core rate could creep up by "a couple of tenths" in coming months. "But I don't see that as a breaking-out of inflation," he said.
